title: Choosing a mobile plan
body: A person is choosing between two mobile plans. Plan A charges a monthly fee of ₹50 plus ₹0.20 per minute of call time. Plan B charges a monthly fee of ₹30 plus ₹0.30 per minute of call time. If t is the number of minutes of calling in a month and C is the monthly cost in rupees, each plan gives a linear equation in the two variables t and C. Drawing both lines on the same graph, with t on the x-axis and C on the y-axis, shows how the two plans compare. The point where the two lines intersect gives the number of minutes at which both plans cost the same, and the slopes of the lines show how fast each cost grows.
